'''Michael Girard''' was named on Decipher's first team of Star Wars '''Player Advocates''' (Players' Committee), listed under '''Player Support'''.<ref name="pc1">[https://web.archive.org/web/20020611042314/http://decipher.com/starwars/playerscommittee1.html The Star Wars Players' Committee], decipher.com (Wayback, 11 June 2002; letter dated 25 January 2002 by Warren Holland)</ref>

This page is a '''fan encyclopedia''' stub. No biography beyond that announcement is asserted here.

== Documented PC role ==

* '''January 2002:''' First Advocates roster &mdash; Player Support.<ref name="pc1" />
* One of six Advocates scheduled to meet Decipher in Norfolk to discuss turning Star Wars CCG over to players.<ref name="pc1" />

He is '''not''' listed on the swccgpc.com Advocate Council captures used on [[Players Committee advocates]] (December 2002 / 2004 / 2005). Exact end of the Player Support term is not dated in those sources.
